LanguageData.MXNL_QingheFlowerCourtStart.label: Flower Court's First Bloom
LanguageData.MXNL_QingheFlowerCourtStart.description:
Day after day of secluded cultivation cannot answer every question. Hearing that your teacher Neiyu has come to the RimWorld, you leave your familiar garden and arrive alone on this isolated ground to follow in her footsteps.
This time, there is only you, a little traveling gear, and a piece of unsettled land.
LanguageData.MXNL_QingheFlowerCourtStart.scenario.sum: A fairy among the flowers arrives on the RimWorld, seeking to let the blessings of the hundred flowers take root in an unfamiliar land.
LanguageData.MXNL_QingheFlowerCourtStart.scenario.par:
Day after day of secluded cultivation cannot answer every question.
Following your teacher Neiyu, you leave your familiar garden and arrive alone on this RimWorld to follow in her footsteps.
You have only a little traveling gear and a piece of unsettled land.
Survive first, then find a way to build a new garden and awaken your power again.
